title: Client Service Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
department: Business Development / Client Relations / HR Operations
content:
## Client Service Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Document Type:** Client Service & Staffing Operations SOP
**Department:** Business Development / Client Relations / HR Operations
**Applicable To:** All Clients, Business Partners, HR Teams, Recruitment Teams, Payroll Teams, and Service Delivery Teams of Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd.
**Effective Date:** ____________________
**Version:** 1.0

---

# 1. Purpose

This Client Service SOP defines the standard process for client onboarding, requirement management, recruitment delivery, staffing operations, payroll support, compliance coordination, communication, confidentiality, invoicing, and service governance for all services provided by **Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd.**

The objective is to ensure transparent, professional, timely, and compliant delivery of our **All-in-One Staffing & HR Solutions**.

---

# 2. About Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd.

Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd. is an integrated staffing and HR solutions company offering end-to-end workforce management services across India.

## Our Service Portfolio

### A. Staffing & Recruitment Services

* Permanent Recruitment (IT & Non-IT)
* Contract Staffing
* Temporary Staffing
* Bulk / Mass Hiring
* Executive Search
* Industrial Manpower Recruitment
* Hospitality Staffing
* Facility Management Staffing

### B. HR Outsourcing Services

* Payroll Processing
* Attendance Management
* Leave Management
* HR Documentation
* Offer & Appointment Letter Support
* Employee Lifecycle Management
* Exit Management

### C. Compliance Services

* PF Registration & Compliance
* ESIC Registration & Compliance
* Labour Law Compliance
* Statutory Documentation
* Audit Support

### D. Technology Solutions

* HRMS (SaaS Based)
* AI Attendance System
* AI Interview System
* Employee Verification Portal
* Recruitment CRM & ATS
* Analytics & Reporting Dashboard

---

# 3. Client Onboarding SOP

## Step 1: Initial Discussion

The client shares:

* Company profile
* Hiring requirements
* Number of positions
* Skills required
* Budget / CTC range
* Location
* Joining timeline
* Service requirement

## Step 2: Commercial Discussion

* Service model selection
* Recruitment fee / staffing margin
* Payroll charges
* Compliance scope
* Payment terms
* Replacement terms

## Step 3: Documentation

The following documents may be required:

* Company GST certificate
* PAN
* Billing address
* Authorized signatory details
* Purchase Order / Work Order / Agreement

## Step 4: Service Activation

* Client account creation in CRM/HRMS
* Dedicated SPOC assignment
* Requirement activation

---

# 4. Client Communication Protocol

## Official Communication Channels

* Official company email
* HRMS portal
* Approved WhatsApp Business number
* Official phone numbers
* Video meetings

## Response Time

* Acknowledgement: within business hours
* Requirement confirmation: within 24 hours
* Candidate submission: as per agreed timeline

---

# 5. Recruitment Service Workflow

## Requirement Receipt

Client provides approved JD and hiring details.

## Sourcing

Candidates sourced through approved databases, portals, referrals, and internal talent pool.

## Screening

Profiles are screened for:

* Education
* Experience
* Skills
* Salary fitment
* Notice period
* Location preference
* Communication

## Submission

Relevant profiles are shared with the client.

## Interview Coordination

Recruweb coordinates interviews and collects feedback.

## Offer & Joining

Offer coordination and joining follow-up are managed by the assigned team.

---

# 6. Candidate Replacement Policy

* Replacement support will be provided as per the signed agreement.
* Replacement is applicable only when:

  * Candidate resigns voluntarily within the agreed replacement period.
  * Candidate absconds within the agreed replacement period.
  * Candidate is terminated for performance or misconduct within the agreed replacement period and documentary evidence is provided.

Replacement is not applicable for role closure, budget change, organizational restructuring, or delayed onboarding beyond agreed timelines unless otherwise specified in the agreement.

---

# 7. Contract Staffing SOP

For contract staffing assignments:

* Employees may be deployed under Recruweb payroll unless agreed otherwise.
* Attendance records must be shared by the client within the agreed cycle.
* Overtime, shift allowance, incentives, and deductions must be communicated before payroll processing.

---

# 8. Payroll Processing SOP

## Client Responsibilities

* Share attendance
* Share leave records
* Share overtime details
* Share salary revisions
* Share statutory changes before payroll cutoff

## Recruweb Responsibilities

* Salary processing
* Payslip generation
* Statutory calculations
* PF/ESIC processing
* Payroll reports

---

# 9. Compliance Support SOP

Recruweb may assist with:

* PF filings
* ESIC filings
* Employee registration
* Compliance documentation
* Audit support
* Labour records maintenance

The client must provide accurate employee data and supporting documents.

---

# 10. Employee Verification SOP

Verification may include:

* Identity verification
* Address verification
* Education verification
* Employment verification
* Reference check

Verification reports are shared through authorized channels only.

---

# 11. HRMS & Technology Usage SOP

Clients may receive access to the company HRMS portal.

## Access Features (as applicable)

* Employee database
* Attendance
* Leave
* Payroll reports
* Offer letters
* Verification status
* Recruitment tracker
* Analytics dashboard

Clients are responsible for maintaining login confidentiality.

---

# 12. Data Privacy & Confidentiality

Both parties agree to maintain confidentiality of:

* Candidate profiles
* Employee data
* Salary information
* Contracts
* Pricing
* Business processes
* Login credentials
* Reports and analytics

Data shall not be shared with unauthorized third parties.

---

# 13. Invoice & Payment SOP

## Invoice Trigger

Invoices may be generated upon:

* Candidate joining
* Monthly staffing cycle
* Payroll cycle
* Milestone completion
* Service delivery as per agreement

## Payment Terms

As per signed agreement / PO / work order.

## Delayed Payments

Delayed payments may attract follow-up, service hold, or other actions as per contractual terms.

---

# 14. Service Escalation Matrix

## Level 1

Assigned HR / Recruiter / Account Executive

## Level 2

Team Leader / Operations Manager

## Level 3

Business Head / Client Relationship Manager

## Level 4

Director / Management

Escalations should be raised through official email or designated support channels.

---

# 15. Client Responsibilities

Clients are expected to:

* Share accurate job requirements.
* Provide timely interview feedback.
* Release offers on time.
* Confirm joining status.
* Share attendance and payroll inputs within deadlines.
* Make payments as per agreed terms.
* Maintain professional conduct with deployed employees.

---

# 16. Recruweb Service Commitments

Recruweb will make reasonable professional efforts to provide:

* Timely candidate sourcing
* Quality screening
* Dedicated support
* Payroll accuracy
* Compliance assistance
* Confidential handling of data
* Transparent communication

Hiring decisions remain solely with the client.

---

# 17. Service Limitations

Recruweb does not guarantee:

* 100% interview conversion
* Candidate offer acceptance
* Candidate retention beyond replacement terms
* Immediate closure for highly niche positions
* Business outcomes resulting from hiring decisions

---

# 18. Meeting & Review SOP

Periodic review meetings may be conducted for:

* Open positions
* Hiring performance
* TAT review
* Payroll review
* Compliance review
* Service improvement

Authorized client representatives should participate in review meetings.

---

# 19. Ethical & Professional Conduct

Recruweb follows a zero-tolerance policy toward:

* Discrimination
* Harassment
* Bribery
* Fraudulent hiring practices
* Data misuse
* Unethical recruitment practices

Clients are requested to support ethical hiring standards.

---

# 20. Termination of Services

Either party may terminate services as per the agreement terms by providing written notice.

Upon termination:

* Outstanding dues remain payable.
* Access credentials may be deactivated.
* Data handling will follow contractual and legal obligations.

---

# 21. Force Majeure

Service delays caused by natural disasters, government restrictions, internet outages, strikes, epidemics, war, or other events beyond reasonable control shall be treated as force majeure events.

---

# 22. Governing Law

This SOP shall be read along with the executed agreement/work order. Any dispute shall be subject to the jurisdiction specified in the agreement and applicable Indian laws.

---

# 23. Client Acknowledgement

We acknowledge that we have reviewed and understood the Client Service SOP of **Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd.** and agree to cooperate with the defined operational process for effective service delivery.

**Authorized Representative:** ____________________________

**Designation:** ____________________________

**Signature & Seal:** ____________________________

**Date:** ____________________________

---

**Authorized Signatory**
**Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd.**

title: Sales Department Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
content:
## Sales Department Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Document Type:** Company SOP
**Department:** Sales / Business Development
**Applicable To:** Sales Executives, Business Development Executives (BDE), Sales Managers, Team Leaders, Account Managers, Telecallers, Field Sales Executives, and Sales Interns
**Effective Date:** ____________________
**Version:** 1.0

---

# 1. Purpose

This Sales SOP defines the official sales process, business development workflow, client communication standards, reporting structure, attendance requirements, confidentiality obligations, and performance expectations for all sales team members of **Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd.**

The objective is to ensure professional client handling, revenue growth, process discipline, and ethical business practices across all company services.

---

# 2. Company Business Overview

Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd. provides:

* Recruitment Services (IT & Non-IT)
* HR Outsourcing Services
* Payroll Management
* PF & ESIC Support
* Facility Management Services
* Hospitality Staffing
* Industrial Manpower Recruitment
* HRMS (SaaS) Solutions
* AI Attendance System
* AI Interview System
* Employee Verification Services
* Compliance & HR Consulting Services

---

# 3. Sales Department Objectives

* Generate new business opportunities.
* Acquire and retain clients.
* Achieve assigned revenue targets.
* Maintain strong client relationships.
* Promote all company services professionally.
* Ensure accurate sales documentation and reporting.

---

# 4. Roles & Responsibilities

## Sales Executive / BDE

* Lead generation
* Cold calling and follow-up
* Client meetings
* Proposal sharing
* Requirement collection
* CRM/HRMS update
* Revenue follow-up

## Sales Manager / Team Leader

* Target allocation
* Team monitoring
* Pipeline review
* Deal closure support
* Escalation handling
* Reporting to management

## Field Sales Executive

* Visit client locations.
* Conduct presentations.
* Collect business requirements.
* Submit visit reports.

---

# 5. Working Hours & Attendance

* **Reporting Time:** **09:30 AM**
* Attendance is mandatory through the approved attendance system.
* Field employees must mark attendance as per company policy.
* Work-from-home sales staff must remain available during official working hours.

---

# 6. Daily Sales Reporting

Every sales employee must submit a daily report by **06:30 PM** containing:

* Calls made
* New leads generated
* Follow-up calls completed
* Meetings scheduled
* Meetings conducted
* Proposals sent
* Closures achieved
* Payment follow-ups
* Expected closures
* Challenges/blockers

Reports must be updated in CRM, HRMS, WhatsApp group, or official reporting channel.

---

# 7. Lead Generation SOP

Approved lead sources:

* LinkedIn
* IndiaMART
* Justdial
* Google Maps
* Trade directories
* Industry databases
* Referrals
* Networking events
* BNI / business groups
* Company website inquiries
* Social media campaigns

### Mandatory Rules

* Verify company details before contacting.
* Avoid duplicate lead entry.
* Update lead status immediately in CRM/HRMS.

---

# 8. Client Contact SOP

## First Contact

* Introduce yourself and the company professionally.
* Understand the client business.
* Identify staffing or HR requirements.
* Schedule a detailed discussion.

## Follow-up

* Follow up within the committed timeline.
* Maintain polite and professional communication.
* Record all discussions in CRM/HRMS.

---

# 9. Sales Process Workflow

## Step 1: Lead Identification

Collect company name, contact person, designation, phone number, email, location, and industry.

## Step 2: Requirement Discussion

Understand manpower requirement, number of positions, budget, timeline, and service expectations.

## Step 3: Proposal Sharing

Share approved company profile, service proposal, pricing, and agreement draft.

## Step 4: Negotiation

Discuss commercials only within approved company pricing guidelines.

## Step 5: Closure

Obtain written confirmation through email, agreement, purchase order, work order, or official approval.

## Step 6: Handover

Transfer the requirement to the HR/Operations team with complete details.

---

# 10. Client Meeting SOP

Before meeting:

* Review client background.
* Prepare company presentation.
* Carry business card and proposal.

During meeting:

* Maintain professional dress and behavior.
* Explain services clearly.
* Avoid false commitments.

After meeting:

* Submit meeting report within the same day.
* Update CRM/HRMS.

---

# 11. Proposal & Quotation SOP

Only approved templates may be used.

Proposal must include:

* Company introduction
* Scope of services
* Commercial terms
* Payment terms
* Replacement policy
* Validity period
* Contact details

Unauthorized modification of commercial terms is prohibited.

---

# 12. Payment Follow-up SOP

* Coordinate professionally with clients.
* Share invoices through official channels.
* Maintain payment follow-up records.
* Escalate overdue cases to management.

---

# 13. CRM / HRMS Data Management

Every sales activity must be updated, including:

* Lead creation
* Call remarks
* Follow-up dates
* Meeting status
* Proposal status
* Closure status
* Payment status

Data accuracy is mandatory.

---

# 14. Communication Standards

## Official Channels

* Company email
* WhatsApp Business
* Official mobile number
* CRM communication tools

## Prohibited

* Personal commitments on behalf of the company
* Sharing internal pricing without approval
* Using abusive or unprofessional language

---

# 15. Dress Code & Professional Conduct

* Formal or business casual attire.
* Maintain grooming and hygiene.
* Respect clients, colleagues, and candidates.
* Avoid arguments or aggressive behavior.

---

# 16. Confidentiality & Data Security

The following are strictly confidential:

* Client database
* Pricing structure
* Contracts
* Revenue reports
* Candidate database
* HRMS access
* Business strategies
* Source code, portals, and internal systems

Sharing confidential information without written authorization is prohibited.

---

# 17. Technology & Asset Usage

Company-provided laptop, mobile, SIM, CRM access, HRMS access, email account, and marketing material must be used only for official business.

Unauthorized copying, forwarding, downloading, or external sharing is prohibited.

---

# 18. Meeting & Training Attendance

* Attendance in sales meetings, reviews, and training sessions is mandatory.
* Join meetings on time.
* Camera must remain **ON** during virtual meetings whenever instructed by management for attendance verification.

---

# 19. Leave Policy

* Prior approval is mandatory for planned leave.
* Emergency leave must be informed immediately.
* Unauthorized absence may affect incentives and performance records.

---

# 20. Target & Performance Evaluation

Performance may be evaluated on:

* Revenue achieved
* New client acquisition
* Proposal conversion ratio
* Client retention
* Payment collection support
* CRM discipline
* Daily reporting discipline
* Professional behavior

---

# 21. Ethical Sales Policy

Sales employees must not:

* Make false promises.
* Misrepresent services.
* Offer unauthorized discounts.
* Accept personal commission from clients.
* Engage in bribery or unethical practices.
* Use competitor confidential information illegally.

---

# 22. Prohibited Activities

* Sharing company leads externally
* Taking clients for personal business
* Working with competitors without approval
* Misusing company data
* Harassment or misconduct
* Defaming the company on social media
* Unauthorized recording of meetings

---

# 23. Disciplinary Action

Violation of this SOP may lead to:

* Verbal warning
* Written warning
* Incentive hold
* Suspension
* Termination
* Legal action for data theft, fraud, client diversion, or confidentiality breach

Management reserves the right to report serious misconduct to the appropriate authority.

---

# 24. Exit & Handover Process

Before separation, employees must:

* Return company assets.
* Hand over client data and follow-up records.
* Share pending payment details.
* Transfer CRM ownership.
* Complete clearance formalities.

---

# 25. Employee Declaration

I confirm that I have read, understood, and agreed to comply with the Sales Department SOP of **Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd.** I understand that violation of these policies may result in disciplinary or legal action.

**Employee Name:** ____________________________

**Employee ID:** ____________________________

**Designation:** ____________________________

**Signature:** ____________________________

**Date:** ____________________________

---

**Authorized Signatory**
**Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd.**

title: Human Resources (HR) Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
content:
## Human Resources (HR) Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Document Type:** Company SOP
**Department:** Human Resources / Staffing Operations
**Applicable To:** All HR Employees, Recruiters, HR Interns, Team Leaders, Managers, and HR Consultants
**Effective Date:** ____________________
**Version:** 1.0

---

# 1. Purpose

This HR SOP defines the standard working process for recruitment, staffing operations, client coordination, candidate management, reporting, confidentiality, attendance, compliance, and professional conduct at **Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd.** The objective is to maintain a professional, ethical, and efficient staffing operation while delivering high-quality recruitment and HR services to clients.

---

# 2. Company Overview

**Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd.** is an HR and staffing solutions company providing services including:

* Recruitment Services (IT & Non-IT)
* HR Outsourcing
* Payroll Management
* PF & ESIC Support
* Compliance & HR Documentation
* Facility Management Staffing
* Hospitality Staffing
* Industrial Manpower Recruitment
* HRMS Solutions
* AI-enabled HR Solutions

---

# 3. HR Roles & Responsibilities

## HR Recruiter

* Source candidates from approved portals and databases.
* Screen resumes as per client requirements.
* Conduct telephonic/video interviews.
* Schedule client interviews.
* Follow up with candidates until joining.
* Maintain candidate records in HRMS/CRM.

## HR Team Leader / Manager

* Allocate requirements to recruiters.
* Monitor daily targets.
* Review candidate quality and interview ratios.
* Coordinate with clients.
* Ensure process compliance.

## HR Intern

* Support sourcing, calling, data entry, and follow-ups under supervision.
* Maintain confidentiality of all data.

---

# 4. Working Hours & Attendance

* **Office Reporting Time:** 09:30 AM
* **Working Days:** As per company calendar.
* Attendance must be marked through the approved attendance system.
* Late coming must be informed to the reporting manager.
* Work-from-home employees must remain available during official working hours.

---

# 5. Daily Reporting Process

Every HR employee must submit a daily update by **06:30 PM** containing:

* Number of candidates sourced
* Number of calls made
* Number of interviews scheduled
* Number of interviews attended
* Number of shortlisted candidates
* Number of offers released
* Number of joinings
* Pending follow-ups
* Challenges/blockers

Updates must be submitted in the official group, HRMS, or reporting portal.

---

# 6. Recruitment Process

## Step 1: Requirement Collection

* Receive approved Job Description (JD) from the client.
* Confirm salary, location, experience, skills, notice period, and joining timeline.

## Step 2: Sourcing

Approved sources:

* Naukri
* LinkedIn
* Indeed
* WorkIndia
* Internal Database
* Employee Referrals
* Social Media
* Company Career Portal

## Step 3: Screening

Verify:

* Education
* Experience
* Skills
* Salary expectations
* Notice period
* Location preference
* Communication ability

## Step 4: Interview Coordination

* Schedule interview with candidate and client.
* Share interview details through official communication.
* Take interview confirmation.

## Step 5: Feedback Management

* Collect feedback within 24 hours.
* Update HRMS/CRM immediately.

## Step 6: Offer & Joining

* Coordinate offer release.
* Collect acceptance.
* Conduct pre-joining follow-up.
* Confirm joining on Day 1.

---

# 7. Candidate Data Management

* All candidate data must be entered in the company HRMS/CRM.
* Duplicate profiles should be avoided.
* Personal documents must be stored securely.
* Candidate information must not be shared outside authorized channels.

---

# 8. Client Communication SOP

* Use official company email, WhatsApp Business, or approved communication channels.
* Maintain professional language at all times.
* Share only verified candidate profiles.
* Do not commit salary, joining date, or hiring decisions without client confirmation.

---

# 9. Joining Confirmation Process

After candidate joining:

* Obtain joining confirmation from client.
* Update joining status in HRMS.
* Share confirmation with Accounts/Billing team for invoice processing.

---

# 10. Invoice & Payment Coordination

* HR must provide joining details to the Finance team.
* Invoice should be generated as per the client agreement.
* Follow-up for payment must be professional and documented.

---

# 11. Leave Policy

* Prior approval is mandatory for planned leave.
* Emergency leave must be informed immediately.
* Unauthorized absence may lead to disciplinary action.

---

# 12. Meeting & Communication Discipline

* Attendance in official meetings is mandatory.
* Employees must join on time.
* Camera must remain **ON** during meetings whenever instructed by management for attendance verification.
* Follow management instructions during meetings.

---

# 13. Confidentiality & Data Protection

Employees must maintain strict confidentiality regarding:

* Client data
* Candidate data
* Salary details
* Business agreements
* HRMS access
* Login credentials
* Internal reports
* Recruitment strategies
* Company financial information

Sharing confidential information without authorization is strictly prohibited.

---

# 14. Use of Company Systems

* Use company systems only for official work.
* Passwords must not be shared.
* Downloading or copying company databases without permission is prohibited.
* All recruitment activities should be recorded in company systems.

---

# 15. Ethical Recruitment Guidelines

* No fake commitments to candidates.
* No charging candidates for jobs unless officially approved by management and legally permissible.
* No discrimination based on gender, religion, caste, race, age, disability, or personal background.
* Respect candidate privacy and dignity.

---

# 16. Performance Monitoring

Key performance indicators may include:

* Daily calls
* Resume submissions
* Interview conversion ratio
* Offer-to-joining ratio
* Joining numbers
* Client satisfaction
* Data accuracy
* Reporting discipline

---

# 17. Notice Period & Exit Process

Employees leaving the organization must:

* Submit resignation in writing.
* Complete knowledge transfer.
* Return company assets.
* Hand over data and credentials.
* Obtain clearance from HR, IT, and Accounts.

---

# 18. Prohibited Activities

The following are strictly prohibited:

* Sharing company database externally.
* Using company data for personal business.
* Poaching company clients or candidates.
* Misrepresentation to clients or candidates.
* Absenteeism without approval.
* Harassment, abusive language, or unprofessional conduct.
* Unauthorized social media statements on behalf of the company.

---

# 19. Disciplinary Action

Violation of this SOP may result in:

* Verbal warning
* Written warning
* Performance improvement plan
* Suspension
* Termination of employment/internship/contract
* Legal action in case of data theft, fraud, confidentiality breach, or misconduct

Management reserves the right to report serious violations to the appropriate authority.

---

# 20. HRMS Usage Compliance

All HR employees must regularly update:

* Candidate status
* Interview status
* Offer status
* Joining status
* Client remarks
* Daily activity reports

Failure to update HRMS may be treated as process non-compliance.

---

# 21. Declaration

**Designation:** ____________________________

**Signature:** ____________________________

**Date:** ____________________________

---

title: Developer Project SOP (Standard Operating Procedure)
content:
## Developer Project SOP (Standard Operating Procedure)

**Effective Date:** ____________________
**Department:** IT / Software Development
**Applicable To:** All Developers, Interns, Freelancers, Consultants, and Technical Team Members

---

## Purpose

This SOP defines the official work process, reporting structure, submission standards, confidentiality obligations, and disciplinary guidelines for all technical projects assigned by Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd. The objective is to ensure timely delivery, transparency, data security, and professional conduct across all development activities.

---

# 1. Project Assignment

* Every project will be assigned by the Management Team, Project Manager, Team Lead, HR Department, or Authorized Reporting Manager.
* The assigned developer must acknowledge receipt of the project and start work within the instructed timeline.
* The scope, features, deliverables, and deadline communicated by management will be considered final unless revised officially.

---

# 2. Project Submission Format

Every developer must submit the project in the following mandatory format:

## A. Project Documents

* Requirement document
* Technical documentation
* Installation/setup guide
* Database details (if applicable)
* API documentation (if applicable)
* User manual / admin manual

## B. Project Demonstration Video

* Complete working demo of the project
* Feature-wise explanation
* Login credentials demonstration (if required)
* Deployment / running process demonstration

## C. Source Code ZIP File

* Complete latest source code
* Database backup file (if applicable)
* Environment/configuration files required for setup
* Proper project folder structure

**Submission without any of the above components will be treated as incomplete.**

---

# 3. Project Timeline & Deadline

* The project must be submitted within the timeline provided by management.
* Delay in submission must be informed in writing before the deadline with a valid reason.
* Continuous delay without approval may affect performance evaluation and future project allocation.

---

# 4. Daily Working Schedule & Reporting

* **Work Start Time:** **09:30 AM**
* All developers are expected to begin work by 09:30 AM on working days.
* **Daily Progress Update:** A work update must be submitted **every evening by 06:30 PM** in the official company group, HRMS, project management portal, or designated reporting channel.
* The update should include:

  * Tasks completed
  * Current status
  * Issues/blockers
  * Next day plan

Failure to provide a daily update may be considered non-reporting.

---

# 5. Leave Policy

* No leave may be taken without prior approval from management or the reporting authority.
* Emergency leave must be informed immediately through the official communication channel.
* Unauthorized absence may be treated as misconduct.

---

# 6. Team Communication & Group Participation

* All developers must remain active in the official company communication groups during working hours.
* Important instructions, meetings, updates, and technical discussions shared in the group must be acknowledged and followed.
* Non-responsiveness for extended periods during working hours may be treated as negligence.

---

# 7. Meeting Discipline & Attendance

* Attendance in official meetings is mandatory unless exempted by management.
* Developers must:

  * Join meetings on time.
  * Follow management instructions during the meeting.
  * Maintain professional behavior.
  * Keep the **camera ON during meetings** whenever instructed for attendance and participation verification.

Repeated absence, late joining, or refusal to comply with meeting instructions may be recorded in performance reports.

---

# 8. Confidentiality, Code Security & Data Protection

Developers must strictly protect all company assets, including but not limited to:

* Source code
* Database
* Credentials
* APIs
* Business logic
* Client data
* Employee data
* HRMS data
* Internal documents
* AI models, prompts, scripts, and automation workflows

## Mandatory Rules

* Company code, credentials, and confidential information must **not be disclosed to any external person or organization**.
* All source code must be uploaded only to the **official company repository, portal, Git server, or HRMS** provided by management.
* Developers must provide required project updates/screenshots/WhatsApp communication records to management whenever officially requested for audit or project review.
* Local copies of confidential data must be handled securely.

---

# 9. Restriction on Code Sharing & Technology Usage

* No developer may share company code, database, API keys, credentials, project files, or technical documents with anyone without written permission from management.
* Company technology, infrastructure, AI systems, servers, cloud resources, telephony systems, or automation tools must not be misused for personal, commercial, unlawful, or unauthorized activities.
* Open-source publication, GitHub upload, portfolio upload, freelancing reuse, resale, or third-party distribution of company code is strictly prohibited unless approved in writing.

---

# 10. Compliance & Disciplinary Action

If any developer fails to follow the company work process, security policy, reporting process, confidentiality rules, or management instructions, the management team may take disciplinary action, including but not limited to:

* Warning notice
* Written explanation
* Temporary suspension of project access
* Restriction of system access
* Recovery of company assets/data
* Cancellation of project collaboration
* Termination of internship, contract, consultancy, or employment
* Submission of a report to the authorized concerned person, authority, client, legal advisor, or regulatory body if the matter involves misconduct, data leakage, fraud, intellectual property violation, or security breach.

---

# 11. Employee / Developer Declaration

**Developer Name:** ____________________________

**Employee ID / Internship ID:** ____________________________

**Signature:** ____________________________

**Date:** ____________________________

**Authorized Signatory**
**Recruweb Resources Pvt. Ltd.**
